note: Construction sites and member subobjects (also of a class-template type). At k = 0 both Leaf objects meet in Leaf::self; k = 1 separates them. Without them the Leaf built in pool memory and the Pool member have no dynamic type, and kCFA / L_DCR drop them at virtual calls. SVF Andersen resolves neither virtual call, so L_FC (wired from its call graph) finds nothing: unsound. Our k = 0 L_FC therefore differs from Andersen (main::vtable), hence no .andersen test.
